verdict.rationale: a-Shell is a full Unix-like shell environment and its Shortcuts integration is described as enabling users to 'download, process and release files using a-Shell commands,' implying scripting-based batch workflows, but no evidence explicitly documents loop constructs, xargs, or batch file processing across many items. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of scripting/looping over multiple files, examples of bulk file processing, independent corroboration of batch workflows.
